svg.title: Reviewer findings caught by each Observer pass
svg.desc: A matrix of the blind reviewer's 22 findings against three columns: pass 1 on the agent draft, pass 2 Part A, and pass 2 with the consistency audit. Each cell says detected, partly, missed, not in the draft, or fixed in the enhanced paper.
svg.text: Which of the blind reviewer's 22 findings each Observer pass caught
Pass 1 read the agent draft. Pass 2 read the enhanced paper blind; Part B is the added consistency audit.
Not present (not in draft, or fixed in 03)
Credit refusals at grade 2 break the adverse-step rule
Statute exception versus the welfare ceiling
Grade 4 definition versus the protective stop
Unsourced claim about the triage benefit
High volume: grade 1 is no better
Override certified by the deployer itself
Five conditions versus "needs fewer of them"
Market harms said to be detected late
Queue position versus "access to a service"
Military case thin; compliance argument missing
A uniform error is also uniformly correctable
"No one can answer" versus the answerability test
Findings F1 to F22 come from the audit in 05-blind-review.md. Scores follow a rubric fixed before pass 2 was read (appendix to 07-pass-comparison.md).
One run per pass, scored by one judge who knew which pass was which. The blind reviewer was also an Opus model.
